messages.subject: Fall meeting time: 1-3PM on Wednesdays
parts:
Hi all,

The votes are in and we have selected 1-3PM on Wednesdays as our meeting time for the fall quarter.  We'll meet starting next week in Wickson 2124.

On next week's agenda we'll have:

1. Introductions and discussion of topics for the quarter
2. An tutorial on new debugging tools in RStudio
3. Regular co-work session and Q&A time.

If you only want #3, come at 4PM.  See you next week!

- Noam

P.S. I note that our selected time overlaps with Deb Nemeier's Introduction to R 290 course.  This is unfortunate but Wed 1-3 won by a significant amount, and I hope those students who take Deb's course come in future quarters and make us of this listserv for Q&A in the meantime.
